title: Overwatch 2
short_description: A hero-focused first-person team shooter from Blizzard Entertainment.
description:
Overwatch 2 is a free-to-play, team-based action game set in an optimistic future.

Players pick from a roster of heroes, each with their own abilities.

  Teams of five fight over objectives across maps around the world.

minimum_system_requirements.processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Phenom X3 8650
minimum_system_requirements.graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 600 series, AMD Radeon HD 7000 series
